query: I tried out the new matcha latte at the café near my hotel this morning and it was way creamier than the ones I get back home, I even took a photo of the little latte art heart on top to send to my roommate later. I also found a cute little handmade keychain stand on the walk over, the artisan had all these little animal designs and I picked up a fox one to clip on my backpack. Oh, and the weather here is so much sunnier than the forecast said it would be, I’m glad I packed my sunglasses instead of leaving them in my suitcase. Anyway, I’m currently abroad right now, I have data saver mode turned on and roaming switched off, but none of my mobile apps are loading at all and I can’t get any internet to work on my phone, can you help me figure out what’s going on?
